front: Why is the mean incoming intensity S/4?
back: Sunlight is intercepted by a disc (πR²) but spread over a sphere (4πR²).

front: How do greenhouse gases warm the surface?
back: Surface emits IR → gases absorb (vibrational energy levels / resonance) → re-emit in all directions, some back to the surface.
Extra warming due to increased greenhouse gas concentrations from human activity.
